package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"

	tree "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/decl/components/tree"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/components/tree"
	"github.com/orbit-z/orbit"
)

func main() {
	root := tree.Node{Name: "root", Children: []tree.Node{
		{Name: "a", Children: []tree.Node{{Name: "a1"}, {Name: "a2"}}},
		{Name: "b"},
	}}
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := tree.Render(&orbit.Ctx{}, orbit.NewWriter(&buf), tree.Props{Node: root}, orbit.Slots{}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(buf.String())
	// The depth guard stops runaway recursion with an error.
	err := tree.Render(&orbit.Ctx{}, orbit.NewWriter(&bytes.Buffer{}), tree.Props{Node: deep(1100)}, orbit.Slots{})
	fmt.Println(err != nil)
}

func deep(n int) tree.Node {
	if n == 0 {
		return tree.Node{Name: "leaf"}
	}
	return tree.Node{Name: "n", Children: []tree.Node{deep(n - 1)}}
}
